input.rationale: Paragraph 4.9 is a blanket disclaimer: the PG makes no representations or warranties as to Supplier performance, the performance or reliability of the Wet Segment, or that APCN 2 will be integrated or placed into operation, and the closing words prevent anything in the Agreement being read as a warranty. No express conformance warranty, warranty period or warranty remedy exists anywhere in the document; the only pathway (Subparagraph 4.8, p0124-p0125) is the PG's discretionary exercise of Supply Contract rights subject to Management Committee direction, which is not a remedy running to us. That is walk-away territory (effectively \"as is\"), so this fails the fallback. We therefore insert a short fallback-level warranty (90 days software conformance to documentation, 30 days services) with repair, replacement or refund, and carve it out of the 4.9 disclaimer so the retained disclaimer does not swallow it. We have targeted fallback rather than preferred wording to keep the change minimal; the compliance-with-law element of the preferred position is already satisfied by Paragraph 25.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.

proposal.summary: Add a PG conformance warranty with repair/replacement or refund remedies and carve it out of the Paragraph 4.9 disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 4.9 currently disclaims all warranties, leaving us with no conformance commitment or remedy. We have added a short fallback-level warranty (90 days for software, 30 days for services) with repair, replacement or refund, and carved it out of the 4.9 disclaimer so the two provisions do not conflict.

ops.text: The PG warrants to each other Party that (i) any software supplied in connection with APCN 2 will conform to its documentation for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, and (ii) any services performed by the PG will be free from defects for a period of thirty (30) days following performance. The remedy for breach of this warranty shall be repair or replacement of the non-conforming software or services, or a refund of the fees paid for them.
